text.p: Creative Programming & Technology Ventures Inc said Tuesday that its shareholders have approved a plan to liquidate the company.

The company said it plans to file its articles of dissolution with Colorado authorities in the near future, and that shareholders should subsequently receive a first liquidation distribution of between $1.00 and $1.15 per share.
The company said holders of preferred share will receive $0.001 per share, or about $10,000.
Following this, the net proceeds will be distributed, pro rata, to common shareholders.
It expects to make a second distribution sometime after Sept 13 from an escrow account that, depending on certain circumstance, is expected to yield from nothing to $0.65 per share.
